settings.model.description: Shared across all workspaces. Configure this in User Settings; workspace settings cannot override it. Model used to generate commit messages. **Codex default** uses the model configured in Codex. Changes take effect immediately. If the selected model is unavailable, the extension retries with the Codex default model. The default selection is **GPT-5.6 Luna**.
settings.messageMode.description: Choose whether to return only a summary or include details of code and behavior changes in the message body.
settings.prompt.profile.description: Active prompt profile. `auto` follows the VS Code UI language (Japanese, Korean, or English for other languages). Use **Commit Message Gene: Select Prompt Profile** to load a built-in or saved custom profile. A nonempty Prompt Text overrides the profile text.
settings.prompt.text.description: Optional prompt text for generation. Leave empty to use the active profile text. When nonempty, this text takes priority. Use **Commit Message Gene: Manage Prompt Profiles** to save it as a custom profile.
settings.model.auto: Use the model configured in Codex.
settings.model.gpt-5.6-luna: Use gpt-5.6-luna, if available for your account and Codex version.
settings.messageMode.summary: Return only the Conventional Commit summary line.
settings.messageMode.detailed: Return the summary followed by a blank line and 2–6 bullets describing concrete changes.
commands.selectPromptProfile: Commit Message Gene: Select Prompt Profile
commands.managePromptProfiles: Commit Message Gene: Manage Prompt Profiles
settings.model.auto.label: Codex default
settings.model.gpt-5.6-luna.label: GPT-5.6 Luna
